## [Bed arrived unassembled and in boxes left for me to build! I was shocked.](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64af1fe9706f837cb10ec7c8)
The items I purchased were all very nice. However, I bought a bed (not inexpensive) and it arrived via Fed Ex and unassembled. In all my life, except purchases from Ikea while in college, have I ever had a furniture purchase arrive without it being delivered to the room and assembled if transported unassembled. That was frustrating.

July 5, 2023

* * *

Useful

Share

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 14, 2023

Hi Jennifer, thank you so much for sharing your feedback. We are constantly working with our carriers to get the best possible service and will share this feedback with the appropriate Shipping teams. Some of our beds ship with FedEx Home Delivery and do not qualify for White Glove Delivery services. Oversized beds that ship via FedEx Home Delivery are not assembled at the time of delivery and will be delivered curbside. We apologize for any inconvenience that this has caused you, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.
